# Vendored from the real Open Responses spec: github.com/openresponses/openresponses,
# revision 2026-04-24 (public/openapi/2026-04-24/openapi.json, fetched and confirmed
# byte-identical to public/openapi/openapi.json's "latest" pointer at the time of
# fetch -- see docs/decisions/2026-08-27-open-responses-spec-verification.md).
#
# One line per `components.schemas` entry whose name ends `StreamingEvent`, taken from
# that entry's `properties.type.enum`/`.default` value -- NEVER from its `description`
# field. This distinction is the whole point of this file: fix-round-1 C1 found that
# `ResponseReasoningSummaryDeltaStreamingEvent`'s `description` says
# "response.reasoning_summary.delta" (stale prose) while its authoritative `enum`/
# `default` say "response.reasoning_summary_text.delta" -- the codec's original decoder
# matched the wrong (description) string, and nothing caught it because the Step 0
# gate had only checked that schema *names* existed, not that matched *values* were the
# real enum members. `tests/openai_responses_event_type_tripwire.rs` checks
# decode.rs's matched literals against this list so that class of bug fails a test
# instead of shipping.
#
# Extracted mechanically (not hand-transcribed) via:
#   python3 -c "
#   import json
#   d = json.load(open('openapi.json'))
#   for name, schema in sorted(d['components']['schemas'].items()):
#       if name.endswith('StreamingEvent'):
#           enum = schema.get('properties', {}).get('type', {}).get('enum')
#           if enum: print(enum[0])
#   "
